title: The New IHG One Rewards Credit Card
summary: Earn 80,000 bonus points after spending $2,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.
body_markdown:
## Highlights


### Rewards Rate


17x


points per $1 spent when you stay at IHG Hotels & Resorts


3x


points per $1 spent on purchases on monthly bills, at gas stations, and restaurants


2x


points per $1 spent on all other purchases


### Intro Offer


Best offer of the year


**Earn 80,000 bonus points** after spending $2,000 on purchases in the first 3 months from account opening.


Reward Rates2 – 17X points


Annual Fee$0


Recommended CreditExcellent/Good


## Our Take


### Why We Like This Card


### Other Benefits


- **Automatic Silver Elite Status** as long as you remain an IHG One Rewards Credit Card cardmember.
- **NEW! Get 5 Elite Night Credits (ENC)** on your account opening and at the start of each calendar year, providing a head start towards a Milestone Reward and your next status tier
- **Redeem 3 Nights, Get the 4th Night Free:** Starting in 2027, spend $5,000 on purchases in a calendar year and unlock a 4th Reward Night free when you redeem points for a consecutive four-night stay. This benefit will be available for the remainder of the year you qualify and the subsequent calendar year.
- **10,000 bonus points:** Earn 10,000 bonus points after you spend $15,000 on purchases each calendar year
- **Get one-year complimentary DashPass by DoorDash** ($120/year in value), that provides unlimited deliveries with $0 delivery fees and lower service fees on eligible orders. After that, you are automatically enrolled in DashPass at the current monthly rate. Activate by Dec 31, 2027.*Opens offer details overlay
- **Up to $120 in Doordash credit value:** Get up to $10 off monthly on groceries, everyday essentials, and more on DoorDash through Dec 31, 2027 as long as you remain enrolled in your Chase DashPass membership. Only for enrollees who sign up for this Chase DashPass membership on or after Sep 1, 2026.*Opens offer details overlay
- **Up to $120 Instacart credit:** Receive a monthly $10 Instacart credit, up to $120 annually, plus a complimentary 3-month Instacart+ membership. Service fees and terms apply. Membership auto-renews at $99/yr. Active Instacart+ membership is required to receive your $10 monthly credit. Benefits end 12/31/27.*
- IHG One Rewards Bonus points are redeemable at Hotels & Resorts such as InterContinental(R), Crowne Plaza(R), Kimpton(R), EVEN(R) Hotels, Hotel Indigo(R) & Holiday Inn(R)
- **Baggage Delay Insurance:** Reimburses you up to $100 a day for up to 3 days for essential purchases like toiletries and clothing when baggage is delayed over 6 hours.
- **Lost Luggage Reimbursement:** Provides reimbursement up to $3,000 per covered traveler for the cost to repair or replace checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged or stolen during a covered trip.
- **Purchase Protection:** Covers your eligible new purchases for 120 days from the date of purchase against damage or theft up to $500 per item.
- **Trip Cancellation and Interruption Insurance:** If your trip is canceled or cut short by sickness, severe weather or other covered situations, you can be reimbursed up to $5,000 per covered traveler and $10,000 per trip for your pre-paid, non-refundable travel expenses, including passenger fares, tours, and hotels.
- Member FDIC
- **No Foreign Transaction Fees**
- **$0 annual fee**
